## 🔥 SHARED ERROR HANDLER

Triggered by n8n when ANY workflow with this set as its
errorWorkflow fails with an unhandled exception.
Reusable across all workflows in this instance.
Sends crash details to Telegram.

meta.description: Shared error handler for the n8n instance. Catches unhandled crashes from any workflow that references this as its errorWorkflow and sends crash details to Telegram.
